_note: Rs 1,00,000 budget, Rs 1,000 max loss a trade, Rs 2,000 a day, stop for a review at Rs 5,000 lost in total. Charges are estimates: set brokerage_per_order_inr and charges_pct_round_trip from your broker's charges page and your contract notes. tick_size 0.05 suits most NSE stocks; check yours. broker: "manual" (you type every order) or "indstocks" (india.py broker sends it after your yes; needs INDSTOCKS_TOKEN and a static IP). sl_limit_buffer_pct: how far under the stop the stop-loss leg may fill. nifty_etf: the fund india.py nifty trades for the Nifty 50. For INDmoney's real brokerage (0.1 % or Rs 10 per order, whichever is lower, at least Rs 2, plus 18 % GST) set brokerage_pct 0.1, brokerage_min_inr 2, brokerage_max_inr 10, and charges_pct_round_trip 0.036 for intraday STT, exchange fees, stamp duty and GST. entry_rule: "break" buys on the first 5-minute close above the opening range; "retest" waits for a pullback to that level that closes back above it (retest_tol_pct: how close the pullback must come). trend_filter: true sits out when the last daily close is under its 20-day average.
